dedup_policy.reuseproof: A local source-map/catalog/validation record is evidence to reuse, not a request to redownload.
dedup_policy.skipalreadyfailed: Prior failure/error-only evidence is retained and not retried absent a new digest or transport path.
dedup_policy.noimage: A pre-2008 item with prior non-image/error evidence and no complete exact-2008 empty proof cannot pass the supplement gate.
dedup_policy.fetch_new: Only a future parent-authorized exact 2008 CDX stage, followed conditionally by one entity GET, may proceed.
dedup_policy.normalization: http/https and default-port variants are matched for dedup evidence, while the original logical URL remains unchanged in every item.

temporal_gate.exact_2008: 20080101000000..20081231235959, matchType=exact, all statuses/MIME, no collapse/showNumPages/filter; complete raw response required.
temporal_gate.pre2008: Only after complete exact-2008 empty proof, explicit pre2008_static_supplement metadata, image MIME/format validation, and opt-in validator.

runner.default: dry-run only; no Archive request unless explicit --allow-network --parent-release-token is supplied later
